Welcome to Residence 5I, a stunning 1b+Den/1.5bth luxury home located in the prestigious Lumina community, San Francisco's premier condominium development that defines upscale urban living.
This impeccably maintained unit features a spacious open floor plan with floor-to-ceiling windows that bathe the interior in natural light and showcase courtyard views.  Elegant hardwood floors in the common area with carpet in the bedroom , custom finishes, and high-end appliances create an ambiance of modern sophistication.  The chefs kitchen is outfitted with Gaggenau appliances, Caesarstone countertops, SieMatic cabinetry, and ample space for entertaining. The primary suite is a peaceful sanctuary with generous closet space and a spa-like bathroom featuring sleek, contemporary fixtures and a deep soaking tub.  Residences in Lumina enjoy the World-Class Amenities & full concierge service.  Located just steps from the Embarcadero waterfront, Salesforce Tower, Ferry Building, and premier shopping and dining in SoMa and the Financial District, Lumina offers both convenience and elegance in the heart of the city.  Don't miss your chance to own a piece of San Franciscos most iconic luxury address!
